svg.title: About
svg.desc: Senior software engineer at CoreWeave, on billing infrastructure for GPU cloud computing: metering usage and processing usage data reliably enough to bill from. Mostly Go, on Kubernetes. Before: The New York Times (subscription platform) and AWS (boto3). Into distributed systems, developer productivity, and language design.
